# Miana Painting Co.

> Weekend interior painting in Hamilton & Stoney Creek, Ontario, Canada. One room painted in one day by the owner-painter himself. Fixed price confirmed in writing before work starts. Rooms from $350 (labour only, paint extra).

## Services and prices (labour only, paint extra)

- Standard Room: $350–500 — bedrooms, living rooms, home offices up to 12 x 12 ft; walls, 2 full coats, light prep, floor protection, full cleanup; finished in one day.
- Room + Ceiling: $450–600 — everything in Standard Room plus the ceiling painted.
- Two-Room Weekend: $700–1,000 — first room on Saturday, second room on Sunday; 2 coats in each room.
- Extras (always quoted in writing first): interior doors +$80–120 each; ceiling-only refresh from +$100; dark-to-light colour change, repair work and ceilings over 9 ft quoted individually.

## How it works

1. The customer sends a photo of the room (quote form, text or WhatsApp).
2. They receive one fixed price in writing — the quoted price is the price they pay.
3. The room is painted and cleaned in one day, on a Saturday or Sunday.

## Service area

Hamilton, Stoney Creek, Winona, Grimsby, Binbrook, Ancaster and Dundas (Ontario, Canada). Painting days: Saturdays and Sundays only.
